layers.label: Sky layer
layers.build: Certified operator flies survey missions. Images are stitched into one geo-referenced map and uploaded to the gateway.
layers.test: Check image overlap and GPS error on a marked plot

hardwareSpec.payload: 24MP RGB mechanical shutter camera + Downwelling light sensor
hardwareSpec.flightSpecs: Altitude 40m AGL, 75% forward overlap, 70% side overlap, GSD ~1.2cm/px
hardwareSpec.georeferencing: RTK GNSS / Ground Control Points (GCP) with EXIF geotagging
hardwareSpec.pipeline: Photogrammetry orthomosaic -> NDVI / canopy extraction -> GeoJSON zone grid

layers.label: Ground layer
layers.build: Each node reads sensors on a timer, sends a short packet over LoRa, then sleeps to save power.
layers.test: Calibrate moisture against oven-dried soil samples

hardwareSpec.mcu: ESP32-WROOM-32U with SX1276 LoRa transceiver (868/865 MHz IN865 band)
hardwareSpec.sensors: Capacitive Soil Moisture v1.2 (analog ADC1), SHT31 Temp/RH (I2C 0x44), BH1750 Lux (I2C 0x23)
hardwareSpec.power: 6V 2W Monocrystalline solar panel + TP4056 charger + 18650 3400mAh Li-ion cell
hardwareSpec.dutyCycle: 15-minute wake interval (3 sec active @ 120mA, 897 sec deep sleep @ 15µA)
hardwareSpec.enclosure: IP67 weather-sealed polycarbonate box with PG7 cable glands and stainless steel probe prongs

layers.label: Edge gateway
layers.build: Runs this same web app offline, stores readings, syncs to cloud when internet returns.
layers.test: Run a full day with the internet unplugged

hardwareSpec.processor: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4GB RAM) or Raspberry Pi 5
hardwareSpec.radio: SX1302 8-channel LoRaWAN / multi-node LoRa HAT with +27dBm output
hardwareSpec.networking: Local Wi-Fi Access Point (SSID: SoilToSky-Edge) for tablet/laptop connectivity without internet
hardwareSpec.softwareStack: Debian Linux, local Node.js Next.js runtime, SQLite & IndexedDB store-and-forward queue
hardwareSpec.powerSupply: 12V 7Ah sealed lead-acid battery with MPPT solar charge controller for 24/7 autonomous run

layers.label: Action layer
layers.build: Valve opens on an approved irrigation packet. Spray maps go to a licensed operator. Robot is a phase 2 prototype.
layers.test: Dry run with plain water only

hardwareSpec.irrigation: 12V DC latching solenoid valve driven by MOSFET H-bridge with pulse control (zero idle power)
hardwareSpec.sprayInterlock: 4-point digital confirmation (wind speed, dosage, PPE, kill switch) before MAVLink/GeoJSON emission
hardwareSpec.robotChassis: Differential-drive rubber track robot with ESP32-CAM and ultrasonic obstacle avoidance
hardwareSpec.safetySwitch: Hardware emergency latching kill-switch button + software remote stop packet override

fields.name: Solar Radiation
fields.description: Surface flux in W/m2 (0 to 1500 W/m2)

connectionSteps.title: Ground Sensor Node Assembly
connectionSteps.summary: Connect ESP32 to analog moisture probe and I2C sensors in IP67 case.
connectionSteps.detail: ESP32 GPIO 34 reads analog moisture voltage. GPIO 21/22 reads digital SHT31 temperature and humidity. Powered by 18650 Li-ion battery recharged by 6V solar panel via TP4056 module.

connectionSteps.title: LoRa 865MHz Radio Transmission
connectionSteps.summary: Pack sensor values into 12 bytes and transmit over long-range radio.
connectionSteps.detail: Node wakes every 15 minutes, broadcasts 12-byte binary packet at +14 dBm in the IN865 license-free band. Travels 1.5 to 3 km across crop foliage without cellular internet.

connectionSteps.title: Edge Gateway Ingest & Web Serial
connectionSteps.summary: Raspberry Pi LoRa HAT receives radio packets and feeds the web app.
connectionSteps.detail: Raspberry Pi background listener decodes the 12-byte payload to JSON and sends it to POST /api/ingest. Alternatively, plug a USB LoRa dongle into a laptop and click 'Connect LoRa' in the app via Web Serial API.

connectionSteps.title: Drone Survey Geotag Ingestion
connectionSteps.summary: Import aerial flight photos directly with EXIF GPS tags.
connectionSteps.detail: Survey drone photos are dropped into Stage 1 dropzone. App EXIF parser extracts GPS latitude and longitude, automatically positioning imagery on the 48-zone prescription grid.

connectionSteps.title: Actuator Trigger & Safety Interlock
connectionSteps.summary: Authorized irrigation pulses solenoid valve; spray exports MAVLink mission.
connectionSteps.detail: When human clicks Approve, gateway pulses an H-bridge relay for 50ms to flip 12V latching solenoid valve on the drip pipe. Remote stop kill-switch instantly locks output.
